notes: Domestic rights for 2026 are sold in two club blocs: Libra (exclusive to Grupo Globo: TV Globo, SporTV, Premiere, GE TV, Globoplay) and Futebol Forte Uniao (FFU, formerly LFU), whose matches are split between Record + CazeTV (one shared match per round), Amazon Prime Video (one exclusive match per round) and Globo platforms (Premiere and selected TV Globo/SporTV games). International rights for 2025-2027 are held by agency 1190 Sports for all clubs except Flamengo, which distributes its home matches abroad itself. Several international deals were announced in 2025 as multi-season contracts that include 2026; where a deal was only confirmed for 2025 (Portugal, Peru, Chile) or is listed without a season (Wikipedia: MENA, Africa, Fanatiz/Flamengo TV), the entry note says so. Not included for lack of confirmation: MatchTV (reported by Maquina do Esporte in Aug 2025 as the 'Asia' licensee), Tigo Sports Bolivia (deal ran only to end of 2025 season), StarTimes 228-match deal (dated 2022/2023).

broadcasters.note: TV Globo shows selected matches (mainly Libra clubs; usually Wednesday 21:30 and Sunday 16:00) with regional splits, so the free-to-air match differs by region. Record shows one FFU match per round (usually Sunday 20:30, some Wednesdays), simulcast free on CazeTV's YouTube channel. GE TV streams the round's Globo match on YouTube. SporTV (pay) usually carries about 2 selected games per round. Premiere is pay-per-view with nearly all games (not Amazon's exclusive). Amazon Prime Video has 1 exclusive FFU match per round (38 total).
